title: 4521-ESP-AGE-39-64-0005 R1
summary:
- This document is an engineering specification for the supply of instruments for the Solana project.
- The scope includes all instruments, cables, gaskets, manifolds, etc., as identified in the main specification.
- Supplier must provide a single contact person to monitor and track material purchased under this contract.
- Confidentiality measures are in place regarding the information contained within the document.
- Gate valve - On/Off specifications for Solana project
- Vendor data requirements including 'Vendor Commitment'
- Equipment delivery details with strict schedule
- Spare parts list required with price and delivery information
- Inspection by Abener Teyma personnel before shipment
- Alternate billing cycle notice available from designated agent
- Confidentiality of information and know-how
- Abener Teyma's right to perform inspection activities
